csv_scope_of_work: Nevada County is seeking input from qualified developers interested in leasing and developing an approximately 5.2 acre portion of Lot 6 of the Loma Rica Industrial Park, also known as Assessor s Parcel Number 006-380-052, a County-owned parcel located at the Nevada County Airport. short_description: Developer sought for leasing and developing a 5.2-acre airport industrial park parcel.

- Project is categorized around redevelopment and industrial park development rather than sbp core structural design services.
- Notice states the RFP/Q has been canceled, reducing immediate relevance.
- No technical characteristics indicating structural complexity or innovation are provided.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction cost is stated in the source. Only a 5.2-acre development parcel at an airport industrial park is identified; no building size, program, or improvement scope is defined sufficiently for a realistic estimate.
fee_explanation: No fee information is provided. The notice is an advance developer solicitation and does not define a structural engineering scope from which an sbp fee could be estimated reliably.
references_qualifications: Qualified developers interested in leasing and developing the site; responsibilities include design, financing, construction, operation and maintenance, regulatory compliance, permitting, and environmental review.
